articles.title: How to create a MurihSpace account
articles.excerpt: Sign up as a member, creator or vendor in a few simple steps.

sections.heading: Choose your account type
sections.body: During sign-up you can register as a Member, Creator or Vendor. Creators get storefronts and subscription tools, Vendors can sell products, and Members can join communities and buy. You can upgrade your role later from Settings.

sections.heading: Pick a unique username
sections.body: Your username is your public handle (@you). We check availability instantly while you type, so pick something short and memorable.

sections.heading: Verify your email
sections.body: After registering we send a 6-digit code to your inbox. Enter it on the verification screen to unlock the full app — including the AI assistant. Didn't receive it? Tap "Send code" to resend.
